scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules pnpm-lock.yaml docs/node_modules docs/.quasar docs/dist icons/node_modules
scripts.build: pnpm run build:icons && pnpm run build:docs
scripts.ci:publish:beta: pnpm --filter quasar-extras-svg-icons publish --access public --publish-branch v3-beta --tag beta --no-git-checks
scripts.format: oxfmt --ignore-path .oxfmtignore .github docs icons/build icons/package.json icons/tsconfig.build.json icons/tsconfig.json netlify.toml package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml scripts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check --ignore-path .oxfmtignore .github docs icons/build icons/package.json icons/tsconfig.build.json icons/tsconfig.json netlify.toml package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml scripts
scripts.verify:fast: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm check:icon-versions && pnpm test:smoke
